title: Minor stamina mead

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Minor stamina mead is a Black Forest-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Minor stamina.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Mead base: Minor stamina is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 10 Raspberries
• 10 Yellow mushroom
Six Minor stamina meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
Upon consumption, it restores 80 stamina over 2 seconds.
A 2-min cooldown is applied preventing consumption of another stamina mead.

sections.heading: Other locations
sections.text:
Other than brewing, Minor stamina meads can be found:
• In treasure chests at Infested Mines.
• Destroyed Ancient pots may drop them.
